title: NHM MP Recruitment 2026 – Staff Nurse Posts
shortInfo: NHM MP has announced notification for Staff Nurse posts. Required qualification: 12th pass, B.Sc Nursing or GNM, Post Basic Nursing. Last date to apply: 05-12-26.
howToApply: Candidates must fill and submit the Online Application Form (OAF) available on MP Online web portal (www.mponline.gov.in or http://iforms.mponline.gov.in) on or before 05/12/2026.
Applications submitted through any other medium will not be considered valid.
Candidates are advised to carefully read all instructions and guidelines before submitting the application form.
All mandatory information (marked with *) must be provided in the application form.
Applications with incomplete details, missing signature, or without supporting documents/photograph will be rejected.

Candidates must upload all required self-attested documents at the time of application, including: High School certificate marksheet, 12th marksheet, educational qualification marksheets, valid live registration certificate, MP domicile certificate, valid caste certificate (if applicable), EWS certificate (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable).
All documents must be available with the candidate before the last date of application.
No document submitted after the last date will be accepted.
Once the online form is submitted, no request for change or correction will be entertained after the correction window closes.
Candidates must ensure the application status shows ‘Successfully Submitted’ before the deadline.

howToApply: Candidates must first register on the respective NAPS/NATS Portal based on their trade: For Trade Apprentice (DEO/DDEO): https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in; For Technician Apprentice and Trade Apprentice (HR/Accountant): https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php

Login to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using User ID/Email ID and apply for the apprenticeship openings using the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (Pipelines Division) for the relevant region.

After applying on NAPS/NATS Portal, visit the Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ and complete Part-I registration by filling basic details (name, category, etc.) and creating a password. Note the system-generated registration number sent to your email/SMS.

Login again with the registration number and password to complete Part-II registration: upload scanned colour photograph (20-50 KB, JPG) and signature in black ink (10-30 KB, JPG), and furnish educational qualification and experience details.
Submit the application. After final submission, details cannot be changed. Take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
Ensure the same e-mail ID and mobile number used in NAPS/NATS Portal are used in the Indian Oil Pipelines portal.
The application window is from 06.11.2026 to 05.12.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.

shortInfo: HCL has announced notification for Trade Apprentice posts. Required qualification: 10th, ITI. Last date to apply: 24-11-26.
howToApply: Register as a Trade Apprentice on the Government of India Apprenticeship Portal (www.apprenticeship.gov.in). Select ‘Establishment Search’ and select Hindustan Copper Limited, Malanjkhand Copper Project. Note the unique registration number generated.
Register your profile on Apprenticeship Portal (www.apprenticeshipindia.org) with registration number as Axxxxxxxxx. Ensure 100% Aadhaar verification and update Bank Account and eKYC in your profile.
Apply online in Malanjkhand Copper Project, HCL as per trade against opportunity creation of HCL on the portal and submit the applied copy print details along with application form.
Submit the online application through the Company’s website (www.hindustancopper.com). Only one application per candidate (One Applicant – One Application) will be accepted.
Upload passport-size color photograph (less than 50 KB, .jpg format) and signature in English in black ink (less than 50 KB, .jpg format).
Candidates who passed ITI in 2025 or prior must upload an affidavit in PDF format (less than 1 MB) on non-judicial stamp paper sworn before a Magistrate or Notary Public.
After submitting the online application, print the Computer Generated Online Application and Acknowledgement Slip and keep a copy for reference.
Both Step 1 (Apprenticeship Portal registration) and Step 2 (HCL website application) are mandatory.
